review: I’m really impressed with this GIZGA sleeve. The neoprene material feels high-quality and provides a good amount of cushion without being bulky. It fits my 15.6-inch laptop perfectly—snug enough that it doesn't slide around, but easy to get in and out. The reversible feature is a nice bonus for a color change. Definitely worth the price for the protection it offers!

This is a really good laptop sleeve. The fabric is good, it’s reversible so can be used both ways, and the thick cover protects the laptop well from dust. The size feels a little big, but not an issue. It looks nice and feels like value for money.The only drawback is that the fabric attracts dust quickly, so even a little makes it look like it hasn’t been cleaned in a while.
Good Product and Very good Delivery service
Good quality however same covers available in less price in market

The thickness is slightly lower than it looks. its not bushy-bushy as you might imagine. But it FITS, that's what matters. It fits my Acer Nitro 5 AN515-57 15.6inch laptop perfectly. It's great. But for some reason, in the packaging i had a strong smell of pest spray that might have used in their warehouse. It went away after i dried it in the sun for a while. Other than this its incredible. The Red one looks great. Since there is no Zipper, the corner stitching might get untangled in the long run. But for the price range, i guess we can buy again if it goes bad 😅

Avoid buying this product. I previously used a Gizga sleeve and was satisfied, but this product is completely different and disappointing. It emits a strong rubber-like odor that makes it unusable. The item I received doesn’t even have a product logo, raising doubts about authenticity. To make matters worse, the seller is refusing to accept a return. I’ve decided to throw it in the bin, absolutely not worth keeping.
